answer: Operator liability escrow pool binds each identity code to an operator, and the onyx check rejects codes reused across wallets. If an operator overlaps codes, enforcement freezes its whole escrow and fines per duplicate, exposing the fable that fresh wallets mean fresh actors. Each extra identity then costs the attacker the per-identity escrow plus a fixed duplicate penalty (e.g. 40 units), and basalt logs tie the seizure to the operator’s payout address.
